items.verbatim_snippet: Following a formal review and final report by health investigator Janice Skot—which examined mounting concerns regarding the hospital's leadership, governance, and quality of care—the Government of Ontario appointed Eric Hanna as supervisor under subsection 9(1) of the Public Hospitals Act to oversee daily operations, stabilize management, and restore institutional accountability.

Following Eric Hanna's decision to step down from the role, the Government of Ontario appointed Carmine Stumpo as the new supervisor to maintain rigorous oversight of hospital operations, further advance governance and financial performance improvements, and guide the progress of the hospital's major $174 million redevelopment project.
